header.title: THE GENESIS DEMO, 1982
header.credit:
W. T. Reeves · Lucasfilm, 1982
Particle systems for the Genesis sequence in Star Trek II.

generation.head: GENERATION LAW
generation.note: Rand() is uniform over [-1, +1]. Birth rate and initial speed vary within each system.

census.head: PARTICLE CENSUS — REEVES 1983 §3
census.footnote: * Fig. 4 mixes one large system with twenty small systems.
census.note: Fig. 6 gives 85,000 / 200 = 425 particles per system. This reconstruction uses 34-frame lives and three layers of systems. The live row is measured; no parameter set is published.

ramp.head: COLOUR IS OVERLAP COUNT
ramp.note: Light adds and clamps: red saturates at 5 overlaps, green at 20, blue at 111. The reconstructed seed is (0.220, 0.050, 0.009).

render.head: RENDER MODEL — THREE PATHS, ONE POOL
render.note: The same 700 particles, with the same streak lengths. Source-over covers earlier light; additive blending accumulates it. The two additive paths should agree.
